# CS and AI: The Complete 100-question English Collection

**100 English preparation entries, 210 worked examples, 169 concepts, and 14 subject areas.**

Start with the complete area map, choose a subject, then open a linked question. Each question includes its source, input/output examples, reasoning, answer, complexity, pitfalls, and related concepts.

[English overview](README.md) · [Question index](INTERVIEW_QUESTIONS.md) · [Complete knowledge map](KNOWLEDGE_MAP.md)

Reviewed **2026-10-17**. Source publication does not establish current hiring use. Company samples, public practice problems, and documentation-derived exercises have separate provenance labels.

## One English collection

This unified bank contains **100 English preparation questions**: reviewed translations of the original 36 entries and the 64 later additions. Every question uses the same format and has a stable ID, a catalog number from 01 to 100, source provenance, worked examples, reasoning, complexity, and knowledge links. The [earlier original-language collection](../INTERVIEW_QUESTIONS.md) remains available as an archive; all 100 questions can be read in English here.

[Interactive English dictionary](https://zhiyuan-deng.pages.dev/dictionary/#home) · [Interactive English map](https://zhiyuan-deng.pages.dev/dictionary/knowledge-map) · [English reader](https://zhiyuan-deng.pages.dev/dictionary/reader)
